description_html:
If you asked me earlier this year how far away we are from superintelligence, I’d probably have said at least the better part of a decade.

But over the last three months, from debating people on and off the podcast, I’ve updated my views a ton.

Let me walk you through how my thinking has changed.

If you want to read the written version (with footnotes and links) you can check it out here: https://www.dwarkesh.com/p/rsi



This is a public episode. If you would like to discuss this with other subscribers or get access to bonus episodes, visit www.dwarkesh.com
